name: meshy-dcc
title: Meshy DCC gateway
summary: Hands Meshy models to the live Blender and Unity. It is served by meshy-dcc-server.exe, which has to be running.

app.name: the Meshy DCC gateway
app.enable: Start meshy-dcc-server.exe (in %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin). Blender or the Unity project must also be open for it to find an instance.

howToUse: Four tools: search, describe, load_skill, call. If search finds no instance, Blender or the Unity project is not open.
